pages: I was the miller's son. I drowned in the race when I was nineteen and they buried me badly, in a hurry, in the rain, and on the third night I heard a voice say get up, there is work, and I got up. I remember my mother's face. I remember that I do not care about it. The Master says that is not cruelty, it is clarity. I have clarity now. I had a mother before.
